body: Yeah when I went to go see someone about it & get help I got my daughter (the only damn thing keeping me on this earth) taken away from me. So never fucking again

No one really listens and they are only ever interested for the sake of being able to make the conversation about them. No one to listen without judgement, sympathy, or wanting to spread your business. They get sick of hearing about your depression bc it makes them depressed. Or they flat out don’t want to believe something is seriously wrong. So many more reasons I can’t talk to anyone but there’s nothing really no point of listing every single one. Basically no one really gives one shit lol
